description_en: Retrieves information about a route target group instance
description_zh: 获取路由目标组实例信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc get-route-target-group --route-target-group-id rtg-xxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetRouteTargetGroup

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the routing target group member
parameters.name: route_target_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to which the route target group belongs. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 路由目标组所属地域的ID。您可以通过调用DescribeRegions接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

A tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。如需传入该值，则不能输入空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。最多支持输入20个标签值。如需传入该值，可以输入空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

ConfigMode.description_en:
The configuration mode of the route target group. Valid values:

Active-Standby: active/standby mode
ConfigMode.description_zh:
路由目标组的配置模式，支持模式如下：

Active-Standby: 主备模式

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the route target group was created
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建路由目标组的时间

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the VPC to which the route target group belongs. You can call the [DescribeRegions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html） operation to query the region ID
RegionId.description_zh: 路由目标组所属的VPC的地域ID。您可以通过调用DescribeRegions接口获取地域ID

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the route target group belongs
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 要查询的路由目标组所属资源组的ID

RouteTargetGroupDescription.description_en: The description of the route target group

RouteTargetGroupId.description_en: The instance ID of the routing target group

RouteTargetGroupName.description_en: The name of the route target group

RouteTargetMemberList.description_en: The member list of the route target group
RouteTargetMemberList.description_zh: 路由目标组的成员列表

EnableStatus.description_en:
The enable status of the route target group member. Valid values:

Enable: Enabled.
Disable: Disabled.

Only route target group members in the disabled state can be replaced with other instances. Route target group members in the enabled state cannot be modified
EnableStatus.description_zh:
路由目标组成员使能状态。取值：

Enable：使能中。
Disable：未使能。

只有未使能状态的路由目标组成员允许被修改为其他实例。使能中的路由目标组成员禁止修改

HealthCheckStatus.description_en:
The health check status of the route target group member. Valid values:

Normal: Normal.
Abnormal: Abnormal
HealthCheckStatus.description_zh:
路由目标组成员健康检查状态。取值：

Normal：正常
Abnormal：状态异常

MemberId.description_en: The instance ID of the routing target group member

MemberType.description_en:
The member type of the route target group.

Currently supported types:

GatewayLoadBalancerEndpoint
MemberType.description_zh:
路由目标组的成员类型。

当前支持的类型：

GatewayLoadBalancerEndpoint

Weight.description_en:
The weight of the route target group member. Valid values:

100: The member is the active instance.
0: The member is the standby instance.

The weight can only be set during creation and cannot be modified
Weight.description_zh:
路由目标组成员的权重值。取值：

100：表示成员为主实例。
0：表示成员为备实例。

权重值仅支持在创建时设置，不支持修改

Status.description_en:
The status of the routing target group. Valid values:

Recovering: The active/standby switchback is in progress.
Switched: The active/standby switchover is complete.
Available: The routing target group is available.
Abnormal: The standby instance has instance failures.
Pending: The routing target group is being created.
Switching: The active/standby switchover is in progress.
Deleting: The routing target group is being deleted.
Unavailable: Both the primary and secondary instances have instance failures
Status.description_zh:
路由目标组的状态。取值：

Recovering：主备回切中
Switched：主备已切换
Available：可用
Abnormal：备实例异常
Pending：创建中
Switching：主备切换中
Deleting：删除中
Unavailable：主备实例均异常

Tags.description_en: The tags of the route target group

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the VPC to which the route target group belongs
